data.design: Built a League of Legends stylized Runeterran treasure hoard prop group centered around a flared Hextech-and-gold armored ironwood chest with a posed open arched lid (chestLid) and front clasp (chestLock), resting on an octagonal runic stone floor plinth and sculpted multi-lobed gold coin mounds. In the foreground sits a jeweled royal sun-crown on a crimson velvet tasseled cushion over a royal purple runner, flanked by a standing jeweled chalice brimming with glowing amethyst elixir, a toppled goblet spilling ruby liquid, a two-handled relic tazza bowl, a tall fluted golden ewer, a hinged gilded reliquary coffer (cofferLid), a pyramid of stamped gold bullion ingots, 20 precarious coin stacks, 300+ scattered coins, stamped hero medallions, and glowing Hextech/arcane crystal clusters.
data.name: Runeterran Treasure Hoard
